info.title: HelloNear API
info.description: The public HTTP API behind https://app.hellonear.xyz (NEAR testnet). Sign in with a NEAR wallet (NEP-413: `/v1/auth/challenge`, then `/v1/auth/login`) or start a try-out session with `POST /v1/auth/demo`; both set the `hn_session` cookie. Chat, approvals, attack and workflow runs stream server-sent events; every event type is described in docs/api-contract.md §3.

post.summary: Meta-transaction relayer: HelloNear pays the gas for an owner's signed registry call (NEP-366)
post.description: The owner signs a delegate action in their own NEAR wallet; the relayer wraps it in a transaction and pays the gas. Only for `REGISTRY_CONTRACT_ID`, only `unequip_skill` and `set_wallet` with exactly 1 yoctoNEAR (the relayer would pay any deposit), at most 4 calls of at most 30 Tgas, a full-access key, a nonce above the key's, and an expiry at most 1000 blocks ahead. 10 per owner per hour.

200.description: `{ txHash, status: "success" | "failure", senderId, receiverId, methods, failure? }`

400.description: `invalid_signed_delegate | receiver_not_allowed | method_not_allowed | deposit_not_allowed | action_not_allowed | too_many_actions | gas_too_high | args_too_large | args_not_json | unsupported_key_type | bad_signature | delegate_expired | delegate_ttl_too_long | unknown_access_key | key_not_full_access | stale_nonce`
